verdict.rationale: The product lets you choose where your data goes. Run history (screenshots, taps, swipes) is kept on the phone, the endpoint key is stored in the Keychain, and you can point the agent at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including self-hosted vLLM, llama.cpp or Ollama. That means you can keep inference data on your own infrastructure instead of a third-party cloud. It is not a region or residency selector, though, and storage of run data is fixed on-device rather than configurable. Missing for 10: an explicit region/residency selection or documentation, a documented data-flow or privacy statement covering what reaches the endpoint, and independent corroboration.
